body:
Source: GitHub issues #614 and #407 (P1-high). Re-verified on main @ 920973bb.
(a) #614: packages/core/lib/mutate.mjs:531-534 treats a body line as an add only if it starts with '+' and not '+++', and a delete only if '-' and not '---'. A deleted source line '---' renders as '----' and an added '++x' renders as '+++x'; the former falls through (shifting every later line number in the hunk), the latter is dropped. Repro: diff with context 'const a = 1;', deleted '---', added 'const b = 2;' -> changedLinesFromDiff returns Set{3}, correct is Set{2}. This is the diff-scoping primitive of the mutation gate and review-calibration: a wrong line prosecutes an untouched line and still prints success (false-green).
(b) #407: packages/core/lib/llm.mjs:96 usageFromGemini maps promptTokenCount/candidatesTokenCount/cachedContentTokenCount and never reads thoughtsTokenCount, so every Gemini completion under-reports billed output and skews phase-share diagnostics in gate-manifest spend.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package packages/core (lib/mutate.mjs, lib/llm.mjs). Tests: npm test -w packages/core from the worktree root. Existing tests mutate-value-substitute.test.mjs and llm-agy-stdin.test.mjs pin other behaviour (rails). Consumers to grep first: grep -rln "changedLinesFromDiff\|usageFromGemini\|@adlc/core" packages/*/lib scripts — hollow-test, review-calibration, scripts/mutation-gate.mjs, gate-manifest/lib/spend.mjs. Name their test files and run them.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. changedLinesFromDiff consumes the per-file header pair ('--- a/…' then '+++ b/…', always before the first '@@') exactly once per file, and inside a hunk classifies every body line by its FIRST character only: '+' add, '-' delete, ' ' context, '\\' no-newline marker. Hunk line counts from the @@ header may be used to know when the body ends. No change to the returned shape.
2. usageFromGemini returns outputTokens = candidatesTokenCount + thoughtsTokenCount (each defaulting to 0). Verify the field name 'thoughtsTokenCount' against the SDK/API docs or a captured response and pin it with a fixture so a rename fails a test. inputTokens and cachedTokens unchanged; Anthropic and OpenAI mappings unchanged.
3. No-thinking Gemini responses produce byte-identical usage to today.
4. Documentation: update packages/core/README.md and make the SAME edit by hand in apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/core.mdx (hand-maintained mirror — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Deleted '---' line: changed set equals the correct line (2 in the issue repro). verify: `node --test packages/core/test/diff-lines-and-gemini-usage.test.mjs`
- AC2 Added '++x' line is included in the changed set. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/diff-lines-and-gemini-usage.test.mjs`
- AC3 Multi-hunk, multi-file diffs with header-like body lines give exact sets; ordinary diffs unchanged. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/diff-lines-and-gemini-usage.test.mjs`
- AC4 Gemini fixture with thoughtsTokenCount asserts the exact numeric outputTokens; fixture without it is unchanged. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/diff-lines-and-gemini-usage.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite and consumers green. verify: `npm test -w packages/core` and the consumer tests named in the lane.
- AC6 Docs updated where core README/mdx describe these behaviours (each phrase >= 1 in both). verify: grep for the new statement in both files.
- AC7 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also --max 80 locally).

OUT OF SCOPE: any other core issue; changing usage shapes for other providers.
title: core: changedLinesFromDiff classifies body lines by first character; Gemini usage includes thinking tokens
